# The Social Kitcchen

The Social Kitcchen is Vapi's premier destination for pure vegetarian dining.

## About Us
We believe that vegetarian food shouldn't be boring. Our expert chefs have crafted a dynamic, multi-cuisine menu that brings bold flavors, fresh ingredients, and exceptional culinary techniques to every single plate. 

## Menu Categories
- North Indian Curries (including Paneer specials)
- Indo-Chinese Favorites
- Italian Pasta
- Japanese Sushi

## Dietary Options
- 100% Pure Vegetarian
- Jain-friendly options available (strictly without onion or garlic)

## Dining & Events
- Dine-in
- Private Dining Rooms
- Birthday Celebrations
- Corporate Dinners
- Anniversaries

## Location & Contact
Address: Shop No. 8 & 109, Shanti Complex, NH-48 (near Mahendra showroom, next to Hi Ice), Vapi, Gujarat
Phone: +91-7567640841
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thesocialkitcchenvapi/
Hours: Lunch 11:00 AM - 3:00 PM | Dinner 7:00 PM - 11:00 PM (Open 7 days a week)
Walk-ins welcome, reservations recommended.
